narr: Another round of thunderstorms produced additional heavy rainfall and flooding. A severe storm moved across northern Stone County producing a brief EF-0 tornado. Additional wind damage occurred across Cedar and Dade counties.
ev: The Little North Fork River at Thornfield exceeded flood stage, rising nearly 10 feet in less than two hours due to heavy rainfall.
lsr: The Little North Fork River at Thornfield as climbed well into flood stage. It rose 10 feet in less than 2 hours.
